# RECORD-SHARE

> Every page of the RECORD-SHARE module of the ABDM Developer Portal, fetchable as markdown.

## Pages

- [Patient scan and record share](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/main/docs/hiecm/v3/api/record-share): A patient scans a facility's QR code in a PHR app and shares chosen health records with that HIU. Base URLs, terminology and the calls on each side.
- [Receive a patient's share request, as the HIU](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/main/docs/hiecm/v3/api/record-share/endpoints/record-share-hiu/01-record-share-post-v3-patient-record-share): Hosted by the HIU, not by ABDM. The HIE-CM calls this endpoint at the callback URL registered for your bridge, so the path below is relative to that URL.
- [Submit the reply to a share request with the data push URL and the encryption key](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/main/docs/hiecm/v3/api/record-share/endpoints/record-share-hiu/02-record-share-post-patient-record-v3-on-share): Acts as the callback endpoint for the PHR application. After the initial request, the HIU responds to this callback with the data push URL and the...
- [Receive the encrypted records at the data push URL, as the HIU](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/main/docs/hiecm/v3/api/record-share/endpoints/record-share-hiu/03-record-share-post-health-information-transfer): Hosted by the HIU at the dataPushUrl it supplied in on-share, not by ABDM. The PHR application posts here directly; the path is whatever the data push URL...
- [Receive the other side's transfer status](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/main/docs/hiecm/v3/api/record-share/endpoints/record-share-hiu/04-record-share-post-v3-patient-record-on-notify): Hosted by the PHR application and by the HIU, not by ABDM. The HIE-CM calls this endpoint at the callback URL registered for your bridge, so the path below...
- [Notify patient record](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/main/docs/hiecm/v3/api/record-share/endpoints/record-share-hiu/05-record-share-post-patient-record-v3-notify): Update the status of the health record transfer process. It is invoked by the PHR application and HIU to notify the HIE-CM about the completion status of...
- [Share a patient's records with the HIU whose QR code was scanned](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/main/docs/hiecm/v3/api/record-share/endpoints/record-share-phr/01-record-share-post-patient-record-v3-share): Is the first step in initiating the health data sharing process. It is invoked by an integrator application (such as any PHR application like ABHA) after...

The HIE-CM calls this endpoint at the callback URL registered for your bridge, so the path below is relative to...

The PHR application posts here directly; the path is whatever the data push URL...
